subject: Post-demo security playbook: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter & portal steps
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Amir Khoury <amir@lumenbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo security playbook: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter & portal steps

Hi Amir — thanks again for your time on the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so your security and procurement teams can move forward:

- LumenBio ask: Type II SOC 2 report (most recent) and interim bridge letter; access to a trust portal for artifact review.
- Redwood steps: provide instructions for portal provisioning, share a Type II delivery window if available, and kick off a vendor security questionnaire (DDQ).

Can you confirm who on your side should receive the portal invite (legal, security, procurement)? If you can share the procurement contact and an estimated procurement timeline that helps us align the release cadence.

For convenience I attached a short "Redwood Type II request" form that we use to track requests and a prefilled vendor DDQ we can send to you to capture the initial answers. If you prefer, we can provision read-only access to the portal for the security team while we prepare the full package.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the primary contacts for portal access (security + legal recommended) — reply to this thread.
2) We provision a temporary portal invite and share upload instructions.
3) You return the DDQ or we walk through outstanding items in a quick 30-min call.

Thanks — aim to get you access within 1 business day after we have contact info.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_DDQ_LumenBio.xlsx (spreadsheet) -- Redwood_TypeII_Request_Form.pdf (form)

Thanks Grace — useful recap.

Quick answers:
- Please invite Sarah Li (Head of InfoSec) and legalops@lumenbio.com. Procurement contact is me for now; if we progress to PO stage I'll loop procurement.
- Our target is to complete vendor review within 2 weeks but legal will need the Type II report and bridge letter before approval for production data.

A couple of follow-ups from our side:
1) Do you have the most recent Type II date range (e.g., reporting period)? We sometimes need that for our internal risk matrix.
2) Where will the bridge letter be hosted or delivered? We prefer a direct upload to a secure portal rather than email.

Looping Sarah for visibility.

—Amir

2) Invite email will include a one-time MFA setup link and a short access guide.
3) Access will be active for 30 days; we can extend if you need additional time.
